第1042章 灵力控制铁球漂浮悬空而不碎的考验（第1页）
顾清寒听完愣了下，疑惑道：“师尊，那你究竟活了多少世了？”
姬云生一愣，有些尴尬回道：“呃！
这个......说实话的话，你这问题我真没法回答你。
当然了，你也不用多想什么，之所以无法回答你，主要是因为我也不清楚，我究竟是转世轮回多少次了。”
顾清寒一愣，再次问道：“那师尊，你究竟有多少妻子呢？”
姬云生又是一愣，缓缓才回道：“我的妻子有很多，不过都是这一世才有的。”
顾清寒一听，接着问道：“那师尊，她们都是谁呢？”
停顿了下后，才开始缓缓说起他的妻子们都是谁。
半个时辰后，当姬云生话语缓缓落下后，这时的顾清寒，满脸懵逼心里喃喃道：“天呐！
师尊的妻子居然那么多就算了，为何他的妻子之中，却是人族、灵族、洛神族、魔族、天使族、妖族、生命神族这些也就不说了，关键是为何还有器灵和天道之子呢？
还有两个连是什么种族的也不知道，可关键她们一个是她师尊，一个还是她师尊为他安排的妻子，这这这.......这关系怎么那么复杂呢？虽说师徒之间并无血缘，但是这样未免，也有点不符吧？”
于此，姬云生见状，无奈开口道：“我说清寒，你看你这又在多想了，
明明我不都说了，我又不是什么好人，所以妻子多了一点又没什么问题。
至于你觉得我是冲师逆徒也好，觉得我是大色狼也罢，反正我还不照样是你师尊。”
顾清寒一听，小脸顿时红了，羞恼开口道：“师尊，你瞎说什么呢！
这些话你怎么能，这么毫无顾忌的说了出来？”
姬云生无语反问道：“这能有什么？毕竟缘分这玩意，谁说的准呢，若是真爱的话，那又有什么能阻挡的呢？”

还是言归正传，既然你已然苏醒了，那么便开始准备考验吧！”
顾清寒一愣，缓了口气才回道：“哦！
紧接着，姬云生开始缓缓如同之前，在给萧潇几女考验前，说起关于考验的简单信息后。
没过一会儿，当他说完后意念微动，两人周围的环境，顿时变成了只有一座千米平方的空旷广场空间。
而后还没等顾清寒回过神来，就见姬云生抬手随意一挥，只见广场中央顿时，
密密麻麻的遍布着，一颗颗玻璃珠大小的，凡铁所制期数百万的铁球后，又见他开口道：“好了，清寒，去吧！
话落，顾清寒愣了下，微微转头看了过去后，缓缓说道：“师尊，那我去了。”
说完就见她身影消失，出现在广场中央位置，
使得这处位置的铁球都向外挪开，露出一个直径一米的圆形空位，而后就见她缓缓蹲下，伸手捏起一颗铁球，仔细看了看后，心里喃喃道：“嗯？这些铁珠子，居然只是凡铁所制，如此看来的话，那这个考验确实还是有点难度的。”
以自身灵力包裹铁球，使其漂浮悬空而不碎起来。
只是事不遂人愿，当她灵力触碰到掌心，这颗被她拿起的铁珠表面后，就听见‘砰’的一声响起，而后就见铁珠炸成铁屑粉末了。

Chapter 1042 The test of spiritual power controlling an iron ball to float in the air without breaking (page 1)
After hearing this, Gu Qinghan was stunned for a moment and asked in confusion: "Master, how many lives have you lived?"
Ji Yunsheng was stunned for a moment and replied with some embarrassment: "Uh!
This... to be honest, I really can't answer your question.
Of course, you don’t have to think too much. The main reason why I can’t answer you is because I don’t know how many times I have been reincarnated. "
Gu Qinghan was stunned and asked again: "Master, how many wives do you have?"
Ji Yunsheng was stunned again, and then slowly replied: "I have many wives, but they are all only in this life."
Upon hearing this, Gu Qinghan asked: "Master, who are they?"
After a pause, he slowly began to talk about who his wives were.
Half an hour later, when Ji Yunsheng's words slowly fell, Gu Qinghan looked confused and murmured in his heart: "Oh my God!
Even if the master has so many wives, why are there humans, spirits, Luo Shen, demons, angels, monsters, and life gods among his wives?
I don’t know what race the other two are from, but the key is that one of them is her master, and the other is the wife arranged for him by her master. This, this... why is this relationship so complicated? Although there is no blood relationship between master and apprentice, this is a bit inconsistent, right? "
At this point, Ji Yunsheng saw this and said helplessly: "Qinghan, you see you are overthinking again.
Obviously I haven't said it all, and I'm not a good person, so having more wives is no problem.
Whether you think I am a rebel disciple or a big pervert, I am still your master anyway. "
When Gu Qinghan heard this, his face suddenly turned red, and he said in embarrassment: "Master, what are you talking about!
How could you say these words without any scruples? "
Ji Yunsheng was speechless and asked: "What can this mean? After all, who can say for sure about fate? If it is true love, what can stop it?"
Let’s get back to the subject, now that you’ve woken up, start preparing for the test! "
Gu Qinghan was stunned for a moment, took a breath and then replied: "Oh!
Immediately afterwards, Ji Yunsheng began to speak slowly as before, before giving Xiao Xiao and the girls some simple information about the test.
After a while, when he finished speaking and his thoughts moved slightly, the environment around the two people suddenly turned into an empty square space of only one thousand square meters.
Then, before Gu Qinghan came to his senses, Ji Yunsheng raised his hand and waved casually, and suddenly, in the center of the square,
Behind the densely packed iron balls, each one the size of a glass bead and made of millions of iron balls, he said again: "Okay, Qinghan, let's go!
After finishing speaking, Gu Qinghan was stunned for a moment, turned his head slightly and looked over, then said slowly: "Master, I'll go then. "
After saying that, she disappeared and appeared in the center of the square.
The iron balls in this position moved outwards, revealing a circular space with a diameter of one meter. Then she slowly squatted down, reached out and picked up an iron ball. After looking at it carefully, she murmured in her heart: "Huh?" These iron beads are actually made of ordinary iron. From this point of view, this test is indeed a bit difficult. "
Wrap the iron ball with your own spiritual power, making it float in the air without breaking.
But things didn't go as expected. When her spiritual power touched the surface of the iron bead she picked up in her palm, she heard "There was a bang, and then the iron beads exploded into iron powder.
